meta.name: manus
meta.description: Delegate complex, long-running tasks to Manus AI agent for autonomous execution. Use when user says 'use manus', 'delegate to manus', 'send to manus', 'have manus do', 'ask manus', 'check manus sessions', or when tasks require deep web research, market analysis, product comparisons, stock analysis, competitive research, document generation, data analysis, or multi-step workflows that benefit from autonomous agent execution with parallel processing.

copy.tagline: 把复杂任务交给AI自主执行
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要处理多步骤、耗时的研究或分析任务。
